methodology: Git source at SHA; tree-sitter C# syntax. Decision complexity counts branch/loop/catch/conditional/switch and &&/||/?? syntax. It includes nested lambdas/local functions and is diagnostic, not control-flow cyclomatic complexity. Collaborator counts exclude common scalar options but can include data/options types; all constructor parameters retained for audit. Churn is commit count through SHA for the current path, without rename following. Primary constructors/data records are separately recorded and excluded from ordinary injected constructor maxima. Parser errors are listed; those files are usable for file size/churn only.
notes: Size/complexity changes describe responsibility ownership, not alone a resolution proof. Frozen ranking unchanged.
Constructor collaborator count is a type heuristic and includes data/options; it is not an injected-dependency census. Primary constructors/records are separate.
PiAgent public option-rich 23-parameter constructor is preserved; no opaque options bag introduced.
Metrics use committed source only. Refactor new owner files add modest total source while separating coherent workflows.
Coverage comparison is separate and diagnostic if optional collector reports known tracker faults.
Phase C independently remeasured committed source at review-record HEAD; production metrics equal Phase A/H03. Original Phase A coverage diagnostics remain retained, with no new source changes.
